title: WorkItem
description: A unit of work governed by the ShipIt workflow engine. State changes are legal only via the validated transition table. The version field is bumped on every accepted transition and enables optimistic concurrency control.

workItemId.description: Unique identifier for this work item

productId.description: Product this work item belongs to

state.description: Current state in the work item state machine (see runtime-flow.md). done is legacy and is never a legal transition target; terminal states are completed, cancelled and terminated.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version, bumped on every accepted transition

designContractId.description: Design contract governing this work item

agentSessionId.description: Agent session that last executed this work item

qaContractId.description: QA contract governing this work item

featureRef.description: Traceability reference to the requested feature

requirementRef.description: Traceability reference to the originating requirement

blockingHumanDecisionId.description: HumanDecision the work item is currently waiting on, set only while state is waiting_for_human_decision

blockingReason.description: Human-readable reason the work item is waiting for a human decision

artifactRefs.description: Artifacts produced for this work item (design revision, evidence, build artifact)

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the work item was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the work item reached a terminal completed state

terminatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the work item was terminated or cancelled
